items.t: Brake booster pump or booster failure
items.job: Replace brake booster and booster pump assembly
items.note: Owners report about $2,500. Lexus extended coverage on some cars, so ask a dealer with your VIN first.

items.job: Oil consumption test; piston and ring replacement if it fails
items.note: Done free under Lexus's warranty enhancement on eligible cars. That coverage may have ended for your car; ask a dealer with your VIN.

items.t: Rear suspension arm can loosen and break (recall)
Uneven rear tire wear after the rear suspension recall
items.note: RepairPal lists about $305-$448. New tires are extra.

items.t: Hybrid transmission short can cut power (recall)
Fuel pump wears out and power drops
items.note: RepairPal lists about $1,619-$1,809. Ask a dealer whether the fuel pump campaign covers your VIN first.

items.t: Brake, ABS and TRAC lights with a Check VSC message
items.job: Brake system inspection and code diagnosis
items.note: RepairPal lists a brake system inspection at about $153-$224. Repairs found are extra.

items.t: Nitrogen leak into brake fluid lowers brake pressure (recall)
Brief loss of braking feel over bumps (recall)
Fuel can leak after a rear crash (recall)
Safety Connect reports the wrong location
items.note: Done free under a Lexus service campaign; ask a dealer whether it is still open for your VIN.
RepairPal lists electrical system diagnosis at about $122-$179. Repairs found are extra.

items.t: Stalling at a stop with throttle code P2111
items.job: Clean or replace electronic throttle body
items.note: RepairPal lists about $729-$838 for 2010-2011 and $1,010-$1,119 for 2012. Cleaning alone costs much less if it works.

items.t: Low-beam headlight bulbs burning out early
items.note: RepairPal lists about $78-$101 per bulb. The modified harness from Lexus costs extra if bulbs keep failing.
